formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) [x3 : DecidableRel x2.Adj] (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ (x5 x6 x7 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x5 x6 → x2.Adj x6 x7 → ¬x2.Adj x7 x5) → (∀ (x6 x7 x8 x9 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x6 x7 → x2.Adj x7 x8 → x2.Adj x8 x9 → x2.Adj x9 x6 → x6 = x8 ∨ x7 = x9) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x4 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ → (∀ (x9 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x9 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x9 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ → x4.size ≤ x9.size) → PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.HasStarProfile x1 x2 x4 → ∃ (x11 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x11 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x11 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ ∧ x11.size ≤ x4.size ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.HasStarProfile x1 x2 x11 ∧ ∀ x12 < x11.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x11 x12).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∃ (x15 : Fin x1) (x16 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x15 x16 ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.Owns x1 x11 x12 x15 x16)
plain_statement: It is false that: For G a graph with no triangle and no 4-cycle, F its edge function, circuits of AND and OR gates with at most two inputs: a least such circuit computing F with the star profile gives one with at most as many gates computing F, with the star profile, in which every AND gate owns at least one edge.
title: It is false that: A step toward: On graphs with no triangle and no 4-cycle, some least AND/OR circuit of fan-in two for the edge function has every AND gate own
